summary: Vale filed a 6-K confirming an agreement to acquire a 30% minority stake in Ligga S.A. via a capital contribution of roughly US$190 million, responding to CVM/B3 inquiry over a Sept 21 InfoMoney report. Ligga operates the Ferro Sul mine in Carajás, with capacity near 2 mtpa expanding to 8 mtpa by June 2028. The deal includes a long-term offtake for 100% of Ligga's sinter feed. Vale deems it non-material; completion awaits customary approvals. Watch regulatory clearance timing and capital-allocation risk.
